senses.en: living an immoral, pleasure-seeking lifestyle, often involving drinking or gambling

example.en: He led a dissipated life in his youth and later regretted it.
example.zh: 他年轻时生活放荡，后来深感后悔。

senses.en: a woman who sells things in a shop

example.en: The saleslady helped me find the right size.
example.zh: 女售货员帮我找到了合适的尺码。

senses.en: in the direction of a place, person, or thing

example.en: We walked to the station.
example.zh: 我们走到了车站。

senses.en: used before a verb to form the infinitive

example.en: I want to learn English.
example.zh: 我想学英语。

senses.en: a native or inhabitant of Spain

example.en: He is a Spaniard who grew up in Madrid.
example.zh: 他是在马德里长大的西班牙人。

senses.en: a small thin sharp piece cut or broken off something

example.en: A sliver of glass was stuck in his shoe.
example.zh: 一片玻璃碎片扎在他的鞋里。

senses.en: to cut or break into thin pieces

example.en: She slivered the almonds for the cake.
example.zh: 她把杏仁切成薄片用来做蛋糕。

senses.en: one of the main numbered or titled parts of a book

example.en: She read the first chapter before bed.
example.zh: 她睡前读了第一章。

senses.en: a distinct period in history or in someone's life

example.en: The invention marked a new chapter in communications.
example.zh: 这项发明开启了通信领域的新篇章。

senses.en: the introduction of new ideas or methods
senses.zh: 创新；引入新观念或新方法

example.en: The company encourages innovation at every level.
example.zh: 公司鼓励各个层面的创新。

senses.en: a new idea, method, or product

example.en: The smartphone was a major innovation in communication.
example.zh: 智能手机是通信领域的一项重大创新。

senses.en: the act or state of being apart or divided

example.en: The separation of the two groups was peaceful.
example.zh: 这两个群体的分离是和平的。

senses.en: a legal arrangement in which a married couple lives apart but remains married

example.en: They agreed to a trial separation before deciding whether to divorce.
example.zh: 他们同意先试分居，再决定是否离婚。

senses.en: the division of something into separate parts or categories

example.en: The separation of waste into categories helps recycling.
example.zh: 将垃圾分类有助于回收。

senses.en: a person or thing that receives something

example.en: She was the recipient of the annual award for best novel.
example.zh: 她是年度最佳小说奖的获得者。

senses.en: Careful study of a subject to discover new facts.
senses.zh: 为发现新事实而对某一课题进行的系统研究。

example.en: Her research focuses on urban air quality.
example.zh: 她的研究聚焦于城市空气质量。

senses.en: To study something carefully in order to discover facts.
senses.zh: 系统地研究以发现事实。

example.en: The team is researching ways to reduce waste.
example.zh: 该团队正在研究减少浪费的方法。

senses.en: following or derived from customs or beliefs passed down through generations

example.en: The parade includes traditional songs and dances.
example.zh: 游行包括传统歌曲和舞蹈。

senses.en: based on long-established orthodox views or conventional attitudes

example.en: The debate contrasted traditional views with modern ones.
example.zh: 这场辩论将传统观点与现代观点进行了对比。

senses.en: usual or happening most of the time

example.en: This is a regular meeting for the team.
example.zh: 这是团队的常规会议。

senses.en: happening at fixed times or intervals

example.en: The bus has a regular schedule.
example.zh: 公交车有固定的时刻表。

senses.en: a customer or visitor who goes to a place often

example.en: The café knows its regulars by name.
example.zh: 这家咖啡馆知道常客们的名字。

senses.en: a person who is hostile to or strongly opposes someone

example.en: She has no enemies at work.
example.zh: 她在工作中没有敌人。

senses.en: an opposing military force

example.en: The soldiers defended the town against the enemy.
example.zh: 士兵们保卫城镇抵御敌军。

senses.en: something that harms or is opposed to a good thing

example.en: Lack of sleep is an enemy of good health.
example.zh: 睡眠不足是健康的大敌。

senses.en: in a way that is very near in space or time, or with little separation

example.en: The two buildings stand closely together.
example.zh: 这两栋建筑紧挨着立在一起。

senses.en: in an attentive or careful way

example.en: She listened closely to the instructions.
example.zh: 她仔细地听了说明。

senses.en: with a strong or intimate connection

example.en: The two teams work closely with each other.
example.zh: 这两个团队彼此密切合作。

senses.en: relating to race or differences between races

example.en: The law prohibits racial discrimination in hiring.
example.zh: 法律禁止在招聘中进行种族歧视。

senses.en: writing done with a pen or pencil by hand

example.en: Children practise handwriting every day at school.
example.zh: 孩子们每天在学校练习书写。

senses.en: a person's characteristic style of writing by hand

example.en: I recognized the letter at once by her handwriting.
example.zh: 我一眼就凭她的笔迹认出了那封信。

senses.en: to make someone familiar with something

example.en: Please acquaint me with the details of the project.
example.zh: 请让我了解这个项目的详细情况。

senses.en: to introduce someone to another person

example.en: Let me acquaint you with my colleague from the Beijing office.
example.zh: 让我介绍你认识我来自北京办事处的同事。

senses.en: clever and funny in speech or writing
senses.zh: 机智诙谐的；妙语连珠的

example.en: She made a witty remark that made everyone laugh.
example.zh: 她说了一句机智的话，把大家都逗笑了。

senses.en: polite and showing good manners toward others

example.en: The staff were courteous and helpful throughout our stay.
example.zh: 在我们逗留期间，工作人员始终彬彬有礼、乐于助人。

senses.en: showing that you think someone or something is worthless or deserves no respect

example.en: She gave a contemptuous glance at his messy report.
example.zh: 她轻蔑地瞥了一眼他那份乱糟糟的报告。

senses.en: relating to technology or technical processes

example.en: Technological progress has changed the way we work.
example.zh: 技术进步改变了我们的工作方式。

senses.en: the act of guessing about something without complete evidence

example.en: There is much speculation about who will win the election.
example.zh: 关于谁会赢得选举有很多猜测。

senses.en: buying and selling goods, shares or property hoping to make a quick profit

example.en: His fortune was made through speculation in the stock market.
example.zh: 他的财富是通过股市投机赚来的。

senses.en: the person who tells a story

example.en: The narrator of the novel is a young woman.
example.zh: 这部小说的叙述者是一位年轻女子。

senses.en: not easy to understand or see clearly

example.en: The instructions were unclear, so we had to ask for help.
example.zh: 说明书写得不清楚，所以我们只好求助。

senses.en: in the opposite way or manner; with an opposite relationship

example.en: Pressure and volume are inversely related: as one increases, the other decreases.
example.zh: 压强与体积成反比：一个增大，另一个就减小。

senses.en: a kind or helpful act done for someone

example.en: Can you do me a favour and open the window?
example.zh: 你能帮我个忙，把窗户打开吗？

senses.en: approval or support

example.en: The new policy has won public favour.
example.zh: 新政策赢得了公众的支持。

senses.en: to prefer or support one thing or person over others

example.en: Most employees favour flexible working hours.
example.zh: 大多数员工赞成弹性工作时间。

senses.en: a person who makes and repairs things made of metal, especially a blacksmith

example.en: The smith hammered the hot iron into a horseshoe.
example.zh: 铁匠把烧红的铁锤打成马蹄铁。

senses.en: a common family name

example.en: Mr. Smith is our new neighbor.
example.zh: 史密斯先生是我们的新邻居。

senses.en: a large industrial city in central England, the second largest city in the UK
senses.zh: 伯明翰（英格兰中部城市，英国第二大城市）

example.en: Birmingham is famous for its industrial history.
example.zh: 伯明翰以其工业历史而闻名。

senses.en: the largest city in the state of Alabama, USA
senses.zh: 伯明翰（美国亚拉巴马州最大城市）

example.en: She moved to Birmingham, Alabama, last year.
example.zh: 她去年搬到了亚拉巴马州的伯明翰。

senses.en: a subdivision of a species, usually resulting from geographical isolation

example.en: The island fox is considered a separate subspecies.
example.zh: 岛屿狐狸被认为是独立的亚种。

senses.en: impossible to bring into agreement or harmony
senses.zh: 不能调和的，势不两立的

example.en: The two sides had irreconcilable differences over the contract.
example.zh: 双方在合同问题上的分歧无法调和。

senses.en: a person who refuses to compromise or be reconciled
senses.zh: 不肯妥协的人，拒绝和解者

example.en: After the split, a few irreconcilables left the party.
example.zh: 分裂之后，几个不肯妥协的人退出了该党。

senses.en: to say harmful and unfair things about someone

example.en: She felt her motives had been maligned.
example.zh: 她觉得自己的动机受到了诽谤。

senses.en: harmful or evil in effect

example.en: The report warned of the malign influence of social media.
example.zh: 报告警告了社交媒体的不良影响。

senses.en: the way someone pronounces words; clearness of speech

example.en: The singer's diction was clear and precise.
example.zh: 这位歌手吐字清晰准确。

senses.en: the choice and use of words in speech or writing

example.en: The poet's diction is simple but powerful.
example.zh: 这位诗人的措辞简洁而有力。

senses.en: a seasoned mixture put inside a bird or vegetable before cooking

example.en: The turkey is served with stuffing.
example.zh: 火鸡配馅料一起上桌。

senses.en: soft material used to fill cushions, mattresses or toys

example.en: The cushion lost some of its stuffing.
example.zh: 靠垫漏出了一些填充物。

senses.en: recurring in regular cycles or repeated periods

example.en: Consumer spending tends to be cyclical.
example.zh: 消费支出往往具有周期性。

senses.en: a person who wants to marry someone; a man who courts a woman

example.en: She rejected all her suitors that year.
example.zh: 那一年她拒绝了所有求婚者。

senses.en: a person or company seeking to buy or take over another

example.en: The struggling airline attracted several suitors.
example.zh: 这家陷入困境的航空公司吸引了几家意向收购方。

senses.en: the state of being without clothes

example.en: The film contains brief scenes of nudity.
example.zh: 这部电影包含短暂的裸露镜头。

senses.en: relating to dogs

example.en: The shelter cares for feline and canine guests.
example.zh: 收容所照顾猫和狗这些住客。

senses.en: a dog, or one of the four pointed teeth next to the incisors

example.en: The dentist filled a damaged canine.
example.zh: 牙医补了一颗受损的犬齿。

senses.en: a substance that keeps insects or other animals away

example.en: Use insect repellent when hiking in the woods.
example.zh: 在树林里远足时要使用驱虫剂。

senses.en: causing strong dislike

example.en: The movie's violence was repellent to some viewers.
example.zh: 这部电影中的暴力让一些观众反感。

senses.en: able to resist water

example.en: The jacket has a water-repellent coating.
example.zh: 这件外套有防水涂层。

senses.en: each one of a group, considered separately

example.en: Every student received a book.
example.zh: 每个学生都得到了一本书。

senses.en: used to show how often something happens

example.en: She calls her mother every Sunday.
example.zh: 她每周日给母亲打电话。

senses.en: all possible; complete
senses.zh: 所有的；全部的；尽可能的

example.en: We made every effort to finish on time.
example.zh: 我们竭尽全力按时完成。

senses.en: to get or obtain something, especially something useful or wanted
senses.zh: 获得；得到（尤指有用或想要的东西）

example.en: She gained valuable experience during the internship.
example.zh: 她在实习期间获得了宝贵经验。

senses.en: an increase in amount, level, or value

example.en: The company reported a small gain in profits this year.
example.zh: 公司今年报告利润小幅增长。

senses.en: to increase in amount, level, or weight

example.en: He gained weight after the holidays.
example.zh: 假期过后他体重增加了。

senses.en: an advantage or benefit

example.en: There is little gain in arguing about it now.
example.zh: 现在为此争论没什么好处。

senses.en: to fall in small drops, or to let liquid fall in drops

example.en: Water was dripping from the faucet.
example.zh: 水正从水龙头滴下来。

senses.en: a small drop of liquid, or the sound of liquid falling drop by drop

example.en: I heard the drip of rain outside the window.
example.zh: 我听到窗外雨滴落下的声音。

senses.en: a medical device that slowly delivers fluid or medicine into a vein (British usage)

example.en: The nurse set up an IV drip for the patient.
example.zh: 护士给病人接好了静脉输液装置。

senses.en: caring too much about small, unimportant things

example.en: They called him petty for refusing to share the credit.
example.zh: 他不肯分享功劳，他们说他太小心眼。

senses.en: small and of little importance

example.en: Don't waste time on petty details.
example.zh: 不要把时间浪费在琐碎的细节上。

senses.en: of minor status or rank

example.en: Several petty officials handled the paperwork.
example.zh: 几名小官员处理这些文书事务。

senses.en: a thin flexible sheet of metal, especially aluminum

example.en: Wrap the leftovers in aluminum foil.
example.zh: 把剩菜用铝箔包起来。

senses.en: a person or thing that contrasts with another and so highlights its qualities

example.en: Her quiet brother is a perfect foil for her loud personality.
example.zh: 她安静的哥哥恰好衬托出她张扬的个性。

senses.en: to prevent someone from succeeding in a plan

example.en: The police foiled the bank robbery.
example.zh: 警方挫败了那起银行抢劫。

senses.en: common or widespread in a particular place or time

example.en: Smartphones are prevalent among teenagers.
example.zh: 智能手机在青少年中很普遍。

senses.en: a person's usual mood or temperament

example.en: She has a cheerful disposition and rarely complains.
example.zh: 她性情开朗，很少抱怨。

senses.en: the arrangement or placement of something

example.en: The disposition of the furniture makes the room look larger.
example.zh: 家具的布置使房间显得更宽敞。

senses.en: the act of getting rid of or dealing with something

example.en: The court approved the disposition of the company's assets.
example.zh: 法院批准了公司资产的处置。

senses.en: to pay back money that you owe

example.en: She plans to repay the loan within two years.
example.zh: 她计划在两年内偿还贷款。

senses.en: to reward someone for their help or kindness

example.en: I want to repay your kindness somehow.
example.zh: 我想以某种方式报答你的好意。

senses.en: relating to the spine or spinal cord

example.en: The doctor ordered a spinal X-ray after the accident.
example.zh: 事故发生后，医生要求拍一张脊柱X光片。

senses.en: a spinal anesthetic, injected near the spinal cord to numb the lower body (regional usage)

example.en: The mother received a spinal before the delivery.
example.zh: 这位产妇在分娩前接受了脊椎麻醉。

senses.en: (British) a small flat sweet baked cake; a cookie

example.en: She dipped the biscuit into her tea.
example.zh: 她把饼干浸到茶里。

senses.en: (US) a small soft round bread leavened with baking powder or soda
senses.zh: 软烤饼（美式，松软小圆面包）

example.en: We had biscuits with gravy for breakfast.
example.zh: 我们早餐吃了软烤饼配肉汁。

senses.en: to imagine or picture something in your mind

example.en: Close your eyes and visualize a peaceful beach.
example.zh: 闭上眼睛，想象一片宁静的海滩。

senses.en: to make something visible, for example with imaging technology

example.en: The scan helps doctors visualize the blood vessels.
example.zh: 这种扫描能帮助医生使血管显影。

senses.en: to become smaller in size or amount

example.en: Wool clothes shrink if you wash them in hot water.
example.zh: 羊毛衣物用热水洗会缩水。

senses.en: to move back or avoid something out of fear or dislike

example.en: She shrank back when the dog barked at her.
example.zh: 狗冲她叫时，她向后缩了一下。

senses.en: informal word for a psychiatrist or psychologist
senses.zh: （非正式）精神病医生，心理医生

example.en: He decided to see a shrink about his stress.
example.zh: 他决定去看心理医生解决压力问题。

senses.en: to carry people or goods from one place to another

example.en: Trucks transport fresh vegetables to the city every morning.
example.zh: 卡车每天早上把新鲜蔬菜运到城里。

senses.en: a system or vehicle for carrying people or goods

example.en: The city needs better public transport.
example.zh: 这座城市需要更好的公共交通。

senses.en: to move someone strongly by emotion or imagination (often: transport someone back/into)
senses.zh: 使心旷神怡；使仿佛置身于

example.en: The music transported her back to her childhood.
example.zh: 音乐把她带回了童年。

senses.en: in a way that saves money or avoids waste

example.en: The new engine runs more economically than the old one.
example.zh: 新发动机比旧的更省油省钱。

senses.en: with regard to the economy or economics
senses.zh: 在经济上；从经济学角度

example.en: The region is economically dependent on tourism.
example.zh: 该地区在经济上依赖旅游业。

senses.en: at some unspecified time

example.en: Let's meet sometime next week.
example.zh: 我们下周找个时间见面吧。

senses.en: former, having held a position in the past

example.en: She is a sometime teacher who now works in publishing.
example.zh: 她以前当过老师，现在从事出版工作。

senses.en: a person who is in the same class or school as you

example.en: I ran into an old classmate at the supermarket.
example.zh: 我在超市碰到了一位老同学。

senses.en: in a way that shows sadness

example.en: She shook her head sadly and walked away.
example.zh: 她悲伤地摇了摇头，走开了。

senses.en: unfortunately, used to introduce something regrettable

example.en: Sadly, the concert was cancelled due to the storm.
example.zh: 遗憾的是，音乐会因暴风雨取消了。

senses.en: a group of diplomats led by an ambassador representing their country in a foreign capital
senses.zh: 大使馆（及使馆全体人员）

example.en: She works at the American embassy in Beijing.
example.zh: 她在美国驻北京大使馆工作。

senses.en: the building where diplomats work

example.en: The new embassy opened near the city center.
example.zh: 新大使馆在市中心附近启用。

senses.en: the ability or desire to compete successfully

example.en: The country's economic competitiveness has improved in recent years.
example.zh: 该国近年的经济竞争力有所提升。

senses.en: in a clumsy or uncomfortable way

example.en: He shifted awkwardly in his chair during the interview.
example.zh: 面试时他在椅子上局促地挪动着。

senses.en: in a way that causes difficulty or embarrassment

example.en: The question was awkwardly worded.
example.zh: 这个问题的措辞很别扭。

senses.en: polite respect shown to someone or their wishes

example.en: He showed great deference to the senior professor.
example.zh: 他对这位资深教授表现出极大的尊重。

senses.en: showy but cheap and of poor quality
senses.zh: 俗艳的，廉价而华而不实的

example.en: The shop sold tawdry souvenirs to tourists.
example.zh: 这家商店向游客出售廉价俗艳的纪念品。

senses.en: stated or appearing to be true, although the real situation may be different

example.en: The ostensible reason for his visit was to attend a conference.
example.zh: 他声称这次来访是为了参加会议。

senses.en: a person who writes the words for songs

example.en: The lyricist spent months writing the songs for the new album.
example.zh: 这位作词人花了数月为新专辑写歌。

senses.en: a young animal, bird, or reptile that has just come out of its egg

example.en: The mother turtle returns to the sea after laying her eggs, leaving the hatchlings to find their own way.
example.zh: 母龟产卵后便返回大海，留待幼龟自己爬向大海。

senses.en: a special right or privilege belonging to a particular person or group

example.en: It is the president's prerogative to appoint the cabinet members.
example.zh: 任命内阁成员是总统的特权。

senses.en: able to move quickly and easily

example.en: The nimble cat jumped onto the high shelf.
example.zh: 那只敏捷的猫跳上了高架子。

senses.en: mentally quick and clever

example.en: She has a nimble mind for solving puzzles.
example.zh: 她思维敏捷，善于解谜。

senses.en: the act of removing dirt, harmful substances, or impurities

example.en: The purification of drinking water is essential for public health.
example.zh: 饮用水的净化对公共卫生至关重要。

senses.en: a religious or ritual act of becoming clean or pure

example.en: The ritual involves a purification ceremony before the festival.
example.zh: 节日前要举行净礼仪式。

senses.en: copies of documents made with a copying machine

example.en: Please bring photocopies of your documents, not the originals.
example.zh: 请携带文件复印件，不要带原件。

senses.en: to make a copy of something with a copying machine

example.en: Can you photocopy this report for me?
example.zh: 你能帮我复印这份报告吗？
